request: 결말, 결말 개방의 펼치고 있는 손가락의 배치가 반대로 되있어. 확인해서 수정해줘
prompt:
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the original ending OPEN illustration with flames surrounding the mirror and a red stone in the mirror. Input image 2 is the CORRECTED ENDING reference, ONLY for the raised anatomical LEFT hand.
Correct only the spread hand in the upper-right of image 1 to match exactly the anatomically correct left hand in image 2: palm facing viewer, thumb on IMAGE-LEFT toward her torso, four fingers fanning upward with the little finger on IMAGE-RIGHT, five fingers total. Use the same hand orientation, natural left wrist connection, position, size and finger pose as image 2. The left forearm still reaches diagonally upward to that hand.
Keep everything else in image 1 unchanged as closely as possible: same woman, face, expression, hair, costume, camera, framing, scale, right hand in the glowing pocket, all flames, mirror, red stone and lighting. Do not replace the open background with image 2's background. Do not mirror the whole picture. The corrected closed/open pair should have the same pose and hand. Maintain the original art style and return 1024x1536 vertical.

observations: 인물 기준 왼손: 손바닥이 관찰자 쪽이며 엄지가 화면 왼쪽(몸 안쪽), 새끼손가락이 화면 오른쪽이다.
엄지 하나와 나머지 네 손가락, 총 다섯 손가락. 손목이 왼팔로 자연스럽게 이어진다.
결말과 결말 개방의 손 모양·자세 대응을 확인했다.

source.note: 원본 PNG는 올리지 않고 sha256만 남긴다

observations: 1024×1536, 주인공 여성 한 명. 읽히는 글자·숫자·로고·틀 없음. 손에 든 책 없음.

결말의 얼굴·의상·자세·화각을 유지하고 불길과 거울 속 붉은 돌이 펼쳐진다.
